Protocol 35: everyone needs 0.8.9
Friends wear their own face, hair and sculpting (bFriendFaces, now on by default)
When your mods differ from the host's, the F1 menu's Compare mods page names them: missing, extra or out of order
The host's hang on a teleport is fixed, and a second hang in the game's physics too
Character names in Cyrillic, Chinese, Japanese or emoji are seen as written
The mod never changes your own gear for a friend; a friend paying in a conversation no longer charges you
A friend's power armor frame made at runtime stands in your game too
Fast loading no longer runs the GPU flat out on a stuck loading screen
Voice chat costs nothing while nobody is in earshot
Full notes on GitHub
